correctness.rationale: The left O(d) commutant on d-by-r matrices is exactly right multiplication by an r-by-r matrix, so ambient equivariance does not force scalar scaling when r>1. Tangent projection, covariance conjugation, Frobenius trust capping, and polar retraction give a direct O(d) x O(r) equivariance proof, and the standalone numerical check agrees to floating-point roundoff.

originality.rationale: The abstract commutant fact and matrix-valued adaptive preconditioning are prior knowledge and are excluded from the novelty claim. The accepted contribution is the source-specific correction of arXiv:2609.19363v1's scalar-uniqueness argument under its stated group action, together with the corrected symmetry classification and the documented prior-art correction. No equivalent public correction or overlapping SCOPE record was located.

value.rationale: The correction materially changes the optimizer design space allowed by the paper's coordinate-freeness criterion: positive-definite column preconditioners and even per-column diagonal scales remain exactly ambient-equivariant. It also identifies direct prior adaptive Stiefel optimization of transformer query/key matrices from 2023, narrowing a central novelty statement while preserving the valid scalar method and its steepest-descent property.
